description: Mint cashback tokens for a purchase at the program's cashback rate, optionally redeeming points first (points_to_redeem or redeem_all) to lower the payable amount. Returns a fee-first calls[] bundle (protocol fee mint, then the customer mint): submit in order (atomically via EIP-5792 if supported), then call confirm_mint_fee with obligation_id, fee_tx_hash, recipient_tx_hash. Unconfirmed fees block future mints.

cashback_rate.description: Override cashback rate (%). If omitted, uses the program's default rate.

points_to_redeem.description: Optional integer loyalty points to redeem at the counter to reduce purchase_amount.

purchase_amount.description: Purchase amount in currency units (e.g. dollars)

redeem_all.description: If true, redeems all available customer loyalty points (up to purchase_amount when positive).
